name: mirage
text: Why live is idle: it's switched off in the settings. Include live games is off, the live master switch is off, and the Pinnodds live feed is off (we dropped it on Oct 25 when you went to the free plan). BoltOdds is also off. SharpAPI, SX Bet and ParlayAPI live feeds are marked real-money but no live lane is running to use them. I haven't turned any of it on: the data is 2 orders, so there's no evidence it makes money yet, and it's real money. Tell me 'turn live on' and I'll enable it (paper first, or real, your call) using SharpAPI's Pinnacle live price as the fair.
